verdict.rationale: 1Password documents primitives that let external systems such as CI/CD pipelines, apps and scripts access secrets non-interactively: Service Accounts, Connect, the Credential Broker, SDKs and the CLI. These are building blocks that other tools run. None of the evidence shows 1Password itself letting a user define automations or recurring background tasks that it executes. Secrets automation for machine workflows is adjacent, not the story's capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
